reviews.text: Really disappointed with today’s visit. I paid over £80 to have my cat’s mats and tangles removed, but there were still tangles left afterwards. The owner did an excellent job last time, which is why I returned, but today a different employee did the grooming and the standard was nowhere near as good. Based on my experience, I’d only recommend booking with the owner herself. To the owner: please make sure your team is properly trained to deliver the same standard. For almost £100, I expected the job to be done thoroughly.
Took my kitten for the first time for a meet and greet and everything was very calm and he was allowed to explore at his own pace. Will definitely be back

Just back from my cats first ever visit having  a meet and greet and a nail trim,  was anxious as my cat can be a little spicy and is nervous at times, but couldn’t have been happier with the outcome full nail trim done and he wasn’t as nervous as I thought, so so happy I will be back, really friendly staff also might only be our first visit but I highly recommend💕
Excellent! Care was taken to ensure Dennis was nice and calm during the appointment.
Attended an excellent feline first aid course run by BluebellPet Care!
I took my cat today for the first time and could not be happier with the experience. Would highly recommend!

Today I took my 1yr old cat, Millie, to Purr for her first ever grooming. I was a little nervous as to how Millie would react, but Saffa was absolutely INCREDIBLE and took the best care of her. Saffa was exceptionally knowledgeable and was able to answer any questions I had. She very clearly loves her job and being surrounded by cats, which is exactly what my gentle girl needed. Saffa and I also had a lovely wee chat while Millie was being groomed. She is an absolute joy to be around. I could not recommend this place enough!!

Another fantastic visit to Purr for my girls, Mama and Teeny! The team here is truly incredible and consistently provides the absolute highest level of care and attention. I love that the girls get so many cuddles and are allowed to just walk around and feel completely at home—it is honestly like soft play for cats! Not only are the grooming results always fabulous, but Mama and Teeny leave as very happy kitties. I cannot recommend them enough for anyone looking for top-tier care!

Britnee, you have created something magical and special, thank you ❤️

Everyone at Purr are incredible and I highly recommend if you have a nervous cat. Unfortunately, Ronnie had a bad experience with another groomer so I was nervous trying again elsewhere but Britnee put our minds at rest during the meet and greet and he has had multiple grooms now. He has also stopped shaking afterwards which is a testament to how amazing the team at Purr are. He even jumps back out of the carrier now to try and stay! Enjoy him in a happy hoodie with Saffa and thanks again to you all for your kindness to Ronnie 💕

Love purr! Pixie has been coming regularly for a full groom for 1-2 years now and always leaves more relaxed than when she went in. All of the staff are great and I trust them entirely with pix. They even do festive shoots for Halloween & Christmas. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to book in!
It was my cats first experience in a cat groomer's  and she was very relaxed in there care.I will certainly be going back.
For a cat that's normally a bit of a wriggler, they really know how to keep Sooty calm. Brittnee and her team all lovely as well!

Linda, my long-haired cat, had a wonderful time in the hands of these two magicians, she immediately felt relaxed.
The staff is lovely and wonderful, and the workshop is beautiful.
Highly recommend for a long haired cat that needs a cut

Amazing services! Amazing team! I have four cats who visit fairly regularly.
Recently we had a consultation visit and decided to give Kevin a teddy cut and finally he hasn't been suffering the heat this season! I wish I had done it for him last year. Life changing for Kevin! (See how excited he is in pics)
Lola and Ralphie visit for nail trims and it is always stress free for them.
Trixie, our semi feral former barn cat who hates everyone visited last week for a long fur brush up groom and just fell in love with Caitlin! Literally this cat only liked two other people in world, me, Britnee and now Caitlin.
Thank you for the care and knowledge and love you show these cats.
I recommend you everywhere!
AQ

A really great service! They took their time and made sure to have a full understanding of my cats temperament before I left her for her groom. Afterwards she looked and smelled wonderful and the staff were really friendly. Would 100% recommend.

We've been taking our cat to PURR for some time now, and she absolutely loves it. They offer a meet-and-greet session so my kitten could get to know the team and feel more at ease before her full grooming appointments. This helped keep her calm and stress-free. Since we have a long-haired cat, grooming is essential. I would highly recommend the wonderful team at PURR!

Such a great experience with Brittnee! She did such a fab job with our wee anxious one. She made sure not to push him too far and let him go at his own pace. My fave part was the picture update during his time there. He smells amazing and is very fluffy again ❤️ big success 😺

edit: over a year later we are still very much in love with the full Purr team! Woody has since experienced his first Teddy Bear cut and he LOVES IT. He's deffo thankful to have such a shed & it makes him look a lot trimmer - lucky him!

If I could give them 10 stars I would. Took my 21 year old cat in who has a litany of issues and the ladies could not have been nicer or more professional! He's never been groomed and I was so nervous but he was a champ and I reckon he actually enjoyed the majority of it! I stayed for the duration like a paranoid helicopter mum but next time, I have every confidence in these amazing women that I'll be going for a cuppa in the cafe next door. He went in a greasy, compacted boy with a serious dandruff issue and came out looking like he was 5 years old again! If ever there was a small, indepedent business to support, this is the one folks! They have a genuine love and bond with cats so if you have any worries, there's no need. Old Man Pecan is now home and looking stunning. Thank you SO much! See you in 6 months!
PURR is the best! Always happy to leave my cat here and the service is 2nd to none! :)
Absolutely love this place & so does Tilly! So much care & attention is made by the team every time we've been from booking our first visit to our most recent. Would highly recommend

This is my 2nd time going to Purr for my cat Gizmo! This time I went and got his teddy cut from Saffa who took such good care of him and had amazing knowledge from the start. Done everything with his cut that we asked for (like keeping his legs all fluffy and shaping around his face and neck) Such a lovely person as well and has so much pride in their work. Will definitely be booking again soon!
the girls were the loveliest most positive people i’ve vet met, i was really nervous going in as my kitten doesn’t do well with nail trims, but they handled it amazingly, will definitely be back!!!
Safa looked after Poppy and Charley really well, gently and lovingly, two timid pussies, really happy

I recently took my cat Caspar (a very fluffy British Shorthair) to Purr after he’d been struggling with furballs, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience.

I was a bit worried he’d be nervous, but as soon as we arrived the staff were so lovely, and the whole place felt really calm and welcoming—which instantly put both of us at ease. When I came to pick him up (slightly early!), I found him in the drier actually falling asleep… he was that relaxed!

He stayed super calm on the way home and for the rest of the day, so I’m pretty sure he enjoyed his little spa trip. Since then, he’s hardly shedding at all, seems much more comfortable, and somehow looks even more handsome than usual. As a bonus, there’s definitely been less hoovering for me!

Would absolutely recommend.

Purr look after our kitties 😸 they have a lovely clean environment.. one cat at a time... its very calming for your cat .They never rush your cat and my cat just loves getting pampered by Britnee and Caitlin. They have a way with the cats .. im so glad I came across Purr this is the 4th groom my cat has had and I wouldn't go anywhere else.. keep up the good work guy's x

My mainecoon cross has been getting groomed here for over a year. She loves it! we’ve peaked through the window before pick up and seen her getting cuddles galore. Lovely and caring staff, who contain the floof, I would highly suggest going here to every long-haired cat owner!

The Christmas photoshoot was also fun (and chaotic) we brought our younger cat along for it as well. Again staff lovely and really attentive to the cats

This was my Ragdoll kitten Chikos second session in Purr. She had a wet groom this time and looked and smelled amazing when we picked her up.
She was chilled out and had behaved herself.
Purr is a fantastic place for cats and kittens.
The one Household policy is a game changer.
I would definitely recommend Purr to any cat or kitten owner. Getting them started young helps. We take both of our kittens so they don't get anxiety in later life if they can't groom themselves for any reason.
Thank you Purr
Great service and grooming. My cat looked great afterwards and all my requests were met. Best cat groomer I have used.
Thank you Brittnee, Lyra is feeling super fresh 🥰 …

We brought our boy Gearge Coony ( Maine Coon)  to Purr last week.
He is a lovely boy but a real scaredy cat and he hates being brushed. He had multiple mates on his chest and tum.
Thank you Brittney. With care and patience you gave him a Lion Cut. He was absolutely handsome, and felt like a wee velvet rabbit.
I will bring George to Purr again to be groomed., Britney was fantastic !
Thank you!

I regularly take my cat to Purr to have her claws clipped.  The staff  are excellent - they really seem to care about the cats and take their time to cause as little stress as possible.  A great location too, just off the M74.
I took my ragdoll here and they were nothing but amazing with her the whole time and she smelled great afterwards aswell 😊 …

Took our cat, Bella for a we spa day at Purr. We were worried about her going as she's a very anxious cat, to our surprise she loved her day and came out looking fabulous and very settled, hair done and nails to. What lady doesn't like the fuss

First impressions count and that's why I'm a returning customer. Brittnee is lovely and my cats feel the same coz they do what she needs them to do no fuss lol. We've not actually had a groom there as not long haired cats just nails trimmed and teeth checked. The unit isn't far from Glasgow City just off the m74 so easy to get to and parking is fine. Highly recommended.

Fantastic professional and friendly service, done an unreal job on my Ragdoll cat Luna. Well worth the money and will be back...
Highly recommend. 5 🌟 service …
Brilliant, thank you.
Great service,  very friendly and professional.  Highly recommend

I was quite nervous about taking my furry princess Penelope for her first grooming session, but Brittnee immediately put us both at ease.

Brittnee took amazing care of Penelope and she looked the best she ever has after her session!

We are already booked in for our next visit 🥰.

Thanks Brittnee!

Brittnee did a great job with my girl, Rune. She has really silky, easy matting fur, and I'd been putting off having her groomed professionally out of fear of causing her stress; but it was fine! Brittnee popped a happy hoodie on her, worked fast, and kept Rune nice and calm. Rune now sheds and matts a lot less, and we'll definitely be back! Thanks Brittnee!

I took Tilly & Milly both Persian Girls to Britnee for the first time.
What a lovely Groomer Britnee is.
A Godsend to Cat Owners.
My Girls had the Lion Cut, their nails trimmed and a lovely bath.
They were so content when I brought them home.
Delighted & Grateful owner👍🙏
A fantastic experience and both cats returned home relaxed and pampered. Highly recommend and we'll certainly be returning customers. Many thanks.

Took my rescued Romanian cat here for his first groom - sceptical about how he would handle things given his traumatic background.
Everything went smoothly (minus the singing when Sky was getting dried!), but Brittnee couldn’t have made the appointment any less stress-free than it was.

Congrats on your recent engagement & myself and Sky will definitely be back!✨🐾

She is absolutely lovely! She's very friendly and bubbly, this was our cat Lucifers first groom hes normally pernickety and is very long haired but she had great recommendations and done brilliant, he loved it and would definetly recommend and return
i took my cat venus in today for a full groom and Brittnee was so lovely, she was very gentle with venus and made her feel relaxed - definitely will be coming back to Purr again venus looks fabulous

Absolutely fantastic with shy/groom avoidant cats. Takes into account the cats limits and doesn’t push them past  those which is highly appreciated. The grooms are done to a great standard considering how wriggly and angry my boy gets during. Would highly recommend this service to anyone with groom resistant cats.

Had both my ragdolls fully groomed and some trims and they look amazing! The staff were very good with them and it was their first groom so very nervous but the girls done great. Will definitely be back and highly recommend.

The best cat salon about. So very attentive to my Juniper Moon, couldn’t have asked for a better service. I turned up anxious and stressed from a hard car journey over with my kitten, we were both looked after and left feeling great. My kitten slept the full way home and is now trying to jump in the shower with me. Wouldn’t go anywhere else with her!

Amazing service, was the first time getting our Ragdolls groomed and thanks to Brittnee’s patience and expertise it wasn’t as stressful an experience as we expected. Will be back for more regular grooms.
Our kitten Benny was treated so kindly and with such care and lots of compliments.

Amazing salon with an amazing groomer. She cares so much about your pet and treats them with the utmost care during their visit.

wouldn't take mine anywhere else.

Went to PURR for 1st time with our rag doll Maggie. Full groom. She's not great with strangers but Brittnee was brilliant with her. Explained to us everything she was doing  and Maggie was at ease with her. Caring and attentive throughout. We'll be taking Maggie back in 3 months time. Deserving of 5 stars 🤩 …

Took my elderly girl Cleo to Purr for her first ever groom and couldn’t have hoped for a better experience! Britnee was so wonderful to talk to, she is an absolutely professional at what she does and she was so good with Cleo <3 her patience and understanding of cats makes her the best person for the job I couldn’t recommend her more :)
Could not recommend this place enough! Britnee has such a lovely nature and did a fantastic job of grooming my short hair cat whilst keeping him calm
My pet was treated with utmost care and friendliness. Squeaky clean service at an affordable price. Highly recommended!

I stayed while my cat got her first groom. It was a functional all over shave for a floofball. I have shaved her at home but she got overstimulated and it always looked like a DIY job. Brittnee was so good at keeping my cat calm and the focus was clearly on my cat's feelings as much as the groom. This is exactly what I wanted for my pampered queen. I am so glad I took my cat here. I will definitely bring her back seasonally when she needs sheered again

We took Winston our 9 month old Siberian cat for his first ever groom today and we could not have been happier!
When we arrived Winston was very shy and nervous, his humans were nervous as well! So we decided to go for a walk whilst he had his groom. When we came back he was lying on the table being brushed and looked so settled and comfortable. Thank you so so much! He looks so smart now aswell. Will definitely come back and recommend to other cat owners 🩵

What a fantastic experience! Brittney was absolutely lovely with my boy Archie. Very kind and you can tell she loves what she does! Archie was super relaxed when I picked him up and spick and span! Can’t recommend enough and I’ll certainly be back when he gets unruly again!

Thanks so much Brittnee!

We had a lovely experience with Brittnee and her team at Purr. She is so warm and welcoming and you can tell that she is passionate about what she does. The salon is so cute too! Most of all though, my Ragdoll came out with an adorable teddy cut and he seemed to be very chill given this was his first grooming experience. Thanks again Purr!

Lenny has been 2 times before and has his next appointment booked will definitely be a regular from now on! You always get such a lovely warm welcome and he always leaves looking beautiful and smelling amazing! Couldn't recommend enough 🥰 …

Absolutely fantastic, paid for a full groom however my kitten wasn't having it as he was stressed for his first time so I was only charged for what was done with no extra fees! Instead he got a dry groom and even came home with extra toys that calmed him down. He looked great and I will definitely be coming back every time without a doubt, thank you!

Second time Brittnee has groomed Jasper. First time was at home and today we went to her new salon.
She made Jasper feel right at home and got his Mani Pedi done in record time which left time for cuddles.
Next visit will be for the full works.
Thanks again. 😸

Had our wee 6 month old kitten for her intro to a wet groom today and Brittnee was not only lovely but so gentle with our kitten. You can hang around and watch for comfort or hang in the coffee shop in the next building. Overall amazing stress free service

Incredible service! Brittnee clearly loves what she does and cares a lot about our cats wellbeing. I took my two cats in for their first ever professional groom after a few failed attempts of grooming them myself at home. I am so impressed at how clean my cats are and how calm they were at pickup!
Wonderful groom and a lovely woman! Clearly knows what she’s doing with getting cats used to being groomed. Will be returning :)
This was my cat’s first ever groom and she came out looking amazing! Definitely a great service. Quick and considerate towards my nervous cat. Will happily book again

Brittnee was SO fantastic with my old grumpy cat who doesn't like being groomed!! The salon is beautifully clean and she took the time to make sure to gently approach all of the grooming processes in a unique way to suit my 10 year old cat. Since we left she hasn't stopped purring she is so much more comfortable and playful!! An absolutely delightful outcome, we have already booked her next groom. Would recommend to everyone, you can really tell that Brittnee cares about her clients and I really appreciate her taking the time to make sure my cat felt safe and comfortable. Was also able to purchase a grooming comb from her so I can keep up with the brushing inbetween grooms! PURR cat grooming is just fabulous.
Can’t recommend highly enough, my cat was a little nervous with it being his first groom but she spent time acclimatising him to the grooming tools. Very friendly and excellent grooming service!
Had my grumpy old man Sebastian in for his groom today. First time at Purr Glasgow. Can’t recommend Brittnee highly enough. He looks fantastic and no sedation needed ❤️

Used PURR for the first time today at their new salon in Morris park. I have a nervous Siberian cat and britanee was lovely, took it all in her stride. My cat is home now getting lots of cuddles and smells lovely again. Will be giving the mobile option a chance next time and see what works best for us.

Very impressed by the pawdicure provided by Britnee. Cat was instantly at ease, and the mobile service is an essential for me as a disabled person. Will definitely use her services again and have already given her card to friends. Hence the 5 stars ⭐.

Brittnee came to my flat to do a hygiene trim and ear clean on my long-haired cat, and she was very friendly and competent and handled my squirmy girl no problem. I'll definitely come back to her in the future :)

Brittnee arrived bang on time, engaged with my cat and cut her claws in a matter of minutes. My cat was calm and completely unperturbed by it all. So much easier and cheaper than a visit to the vet - I will definitely use her services again.

New to Glasgow, I was delighted to discover Brittnee and her mobile service, something I was very accustomed to in the US. Brittnee tidied up my Maine Coon and gave him the sharpest of Lion Cuts. She was patient and gentle with him, clearly communicated her services, and was super punctual. I highly recommend Purr and look forward to visiting their new bricks-and-mortar salon soon!

We have just had a hygiene trim and pawdicure for our cat Fig,  and we are absolutely blown away with how amazing Brittnee was! To say Fig was unwilling would be an understatement, but Brittnee was so patient, skilled, and friendly throughout- Fig is now happily napping like nothing ever happened! We will definitely be booking again in the future
What amazing and professional service. Brittnee is lovely and did an excellent job grooming my cat. She was caring, attentive and patient him. I can highly recommended her services.
Brittnee is always so kind, professional and gentle with Betty's service, making sure she's comfortable and as unstressed as possible

Excellent. Purr Glasgow really delivered. Brittnee was not only highly professional, delivering an excellent service and and a brilliant groom, but she was extremely nice and gentle to our dear cat. I would highly recommend.

Britney was fantastic. Professional, kind, confident with Tinkerbell and just lovely. Tinks got a pawdicure because her claws had started to make her sound like she was wearing stilettos and she would not let us near them. Britney discovered a couple were ingrown so we are very relieved to have got it sorted. Tinks was hissing like mad and whacking Britney (no claws, she's a gentle soul, just hits you with her pads) but Britney was calm and just kept going and reassuring her. Normally if you do something she isn't keen on she will sulk for a bit but she was very happy to let Britney give her a little eye bath afterwards so she must have realised this was a good thing. And it's such a relief to us to know she's not in pain now. I would not hesitate to recommend Britney, lovely cat person.

Wow! A quick 10 minute visit to clip my cat’s nails. I am in awe at how confident and precise Brittney was! My tabby girl was a little restless, but is already relaxing post pawdicure!

10/10 - friendly, confident, and efficient. Thanks so so much.
